name: ONEOK Gas Transportation (OGT) Oklahoma intrastate system

values.PipelineName: ONEOK Gas Transportation (OGT) Oklahoma Intrastate System

researcher_notes: ONEOK's own OGT page says ONEOK Gas Transportation, L.L.C. operates an intrastate system in Oklahoma. It states about 2,471 miles of transmission pipe, a 2.1 Bcf/d peak capacity, pipe up to 30 inches, six connected storage facilities and 12 interstate interconnects. No existing GEM row matches: Enable Oklahoma Intrastate (P0163, 3,540 mi) is a different owner and system, and Cimarron River (P6900) is separate. This is an operating system never captured, not a new build, so the length rule is met by sourced existing pipe. Only one source (the operator page) was found, so tier is medium. The page does not name the operator's parent; owner ONEOK Inc is reused from the existing gazetteer entry and the OGT-to-ONEOK Inc link should be checked. Capacity is peak, in Bcf/d as stated. Diameter is not set because the page gives only a maximum of 30 inches for a system. Intrastate lines are not in FERC filings, so that silence is not a concern; a Oklahoma Corporation Commission check was not done. Route not researched; no route found. Segment-level check recommended: a system aggregate row, so granularity should be confirmed with the team.
